guide_observations.title: Community Dragoon Guide
guide_observations.locator: Rendered current page; mw wgRevisionId/wgCurRevisionId 780419; footer 7 October 2026 18:06. index.php oldid=780419 permanent link returned a Cloudflare bot check (HTTP403) in the built-in browser; not completed or bypassed.
findings: Mixed +3/+4/ranks/augment annotations, omissions and Under Construction sections preserved; no complete idle or useful-MP refresh set in the guide.
Nexus fixed Shining One/Utu Grip compositions are not source-exact; no universal haste/attack/TP threshold adopted.

guide_observations.title: Impulse Drive
findings: Polearm 240; DRG65; quest Methods Create Madness OR equipped Shining One/Kaja Lance regardless of job/skill/quest.
Shining One Impulse Drive damage +40% applies to all hits; fTP 1.0/3.0/5.5.

guide_observations.title: Stardiver
findings: Polearm 357; DRG90 main job; requires Martial Mastery quest and at least one merit (73-85% STR by merits).
Fourfold attack; crit-evasion-down additional effect; Aeonic Aftermath property not available with Shining One.

guide_observations.title: Sonic Thrust
findings: Polearm 300; DRG80 native; conal/rectangular frontal area attack, 40% STR/40% DEX.
Area may engage additional targets; no damage ranking adopted.

guide_observations.title: Shining One
findings: DMG333 Delay480 polearm, WAR/PAL/SAM/DRG; grants Impulse Drive; polearm WS crit +5/10/15% by TP consumed.
Ambuscade upgrade item; no stage/augment; does not grant Stardiver/Sonic Thrust access.

guide_observations.title: Jump
findings: DRG10; 9.5 yalm; recast 1:00 base; Double/Triple Attack apply; jump TP-bonus gear returns TP even at 0 damage.
Ryunohige forced crit/attack bonus not transferred.

guide_observations.title: High Jump
findings: DRG35; sheds 50% enmity as DRG main; recast 2:00 base.
Enmity-reduction gear separate from TP-return gear.

guide_observations.title: Spirit Jump
findings: DRG77; wyvern present: doubled TP return, forced critical, 25% attack bonus.
Peltast Schynbalds +3 TP+90 and Cuissots +3 attack+19% listed.

guide_observations.title: Soul Jump
findings: DRG85; wyvern present: forced critical, triple TP return, 50% attack bonus.
Vishap Mail +3 TP+39 and Vishap F. Gauntlets +3 TP+34 listed; Peltast Cuissots +3 attack+19%.

guide_observations.title: Call Wyvern
findings: Wyvern trait modifications from equipment worn at time of use persist until wyvern dies/dismissed or DRG zones.
Pteroslaver Mail +3 adds support job traits to wyvern; Spirit Surge blocks Call Wyvern.

guide_observations.title: Spirit Link
findings: DRG25; deducts 12-17% current master HP to heal wyvern; requires wyvern below 100% HP unless Empathy merited.
Empyrean hands add removal of erasable/listed ailments; armets do not increase TP transfer.

guide_observations.title: Wyvern (Dragoon Pet) - Healing Breath
guide_observations.locator: Redirect to Wyvern_(Dragoon_Pet) rendered revision 763534; footer 23 April 2026
findings: Healing Breath activates when DRG casts a spell below HP threshold (defensive wyvern: WHM/BLM/RDM/SMN/BLU/SCH/GEO 33.3%, AF head 50%); Restoring Breath forces it regardless of HP/subjob.
Enhances-breath equipment cap 96/256: Ptero. Armet +3 72/256, Brigantia's Mantle 38/256, Glassblower's Belt 5/256; Updraft Mantle breath+ is an augment (1~10/100). Recovery scales with wyvern max HP.

guide_observations.title: Restoring Breath
findings: DRG90 pet command; recast 1:00; forces Healing Breath.
No gear snapshot rule printed on this page.

guide_observations.title: Steady Wing
findings: DRG95 pet command; stoneskin = 30% wyvern max HP + (max-current) HP.
Wyvern HP+ gear must stay equipped through a tic before use; macroing in at use does not improve it.

guide_observations.title: Cure III
findings: WHM21 learned spell, 46MP, 20 yalm range, 6s recast.
DRG99/WHM49 casting also satisfies defensive-wyvern Healing Breath trigger only when actual HP threshold holds.
